title.narrative: Danish contribution to the PPIMA project phase IV

description.narrative:
As part of the PPIMA project phase IV, the Danish contribution will seek to introduce and scale-up NPA’s work around citizens’ environment protection and climate change action awareness, including strengthening citizens, CSOs and local leaders’ policy literacy on human rights and environment & climate change to accelerate commitments to adopting environment-friendly practices and establishing the framework for wider environmental and related social justice. This includes laying the foundation for citizen-led independent monitoring and reporting on duty bearers’ compliance with the environmental and social management safeguards in planning implementing public and community-led infrastructure projects.
The anticipated outcomes are: - Outcome 1: Civil Society partners are more effective in their work to influence and mobilize. - Outcome 2: Citizens acted and participated in decision-making for their rights. - Outcome 3: Local and national government have formulated policies and plans that reflect the concerns raised by citizens and gender equality considerations.
